stories.title: John Lee urges banks to finance city’s tech growth, expand offshore yuan business
stories.summary: Hong Kong’s leader has urged the banking sector to support financing the city’s new economic engine in innovation and technology while expanding the offshore yuan business, a key area for aligning with national strategies. stories.title: USS Lincoln crew hits the streets of Thailand's Pattaya after nine-month deployment
stories.summary: US sailors and Marines streamed into the Thai resort city of Pattaya Thursday after a record-breaking nine months at sea. Local police said there had so far been no major incidents connected to the 5,000-strong contingent of US service members, though two sailors were sent back to the ship after a drunken bar brawl.
